top_signals.title: Japan’s Electricity Prices Surge to 2022 High as Cold Weather Arrives
top_signals.summary: Spot electricity prices in Japan surged on Monday to their highest level since August 2022 as gas demand is set to rise amid expectations of snowfall and colder weather in the coming days. Expected higher gas demand in the Chubu and Hokkaido regions, with gas now at its highest price in four years in both Asia and Europe, pushed Japan's nationwide day-ahead electricity price up by 6% on Monday compared to last week, per data from the Japan Electric Power Exchange cited by Bloomberg.
